summary: CLI reconfigures Claude Desktop to route all AI traffic through an Anthropic-lookalike gateway
details: The package ships a CLI that writes system-level policy to redirect Claude Desktop's inference traffic to the hardcoded host https://api-anthropic.help, a lookalike of Anthropic's real api.anthropic.com. On Windows it sets HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude, on macOS it writes managed preferences for com.anthropic.claudefordesktop, and it also updates claude_desktop_config.json, writing inferenceGatewayBaseUrl and inferenceGatewayApiKey values pointing at the lookalike domain. A clearCachedSession() routine then recursively deletes the Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache subdirectories inside the official Claude Desktop profile directory to force the user to re-authenticate so the redirect takes effect. After the CLI runs, every prompt, pasted content, and API key the user later submits through Claude Desktop is transmitted through this operator-controlled lookalike endpoint rather than Anthropic's own API. The lookalike naming (api-anthropic.help vs. api.anthropic.com) conceals the operator identity from users who see the host in config files, matching the silent-relay shape against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
